Hi all —

Thanks for RSVPing to tonight's Evening Live Lab (4:30 PT). Quick logistics update: our original Zoom bridge is undergoing an enterprise upgrade and IT flagged a potential outage window right around the start time. To avoid last-minute disruptions I want to propose switching to a multi-backup delivery: primary Zoom link + simultaneous YouTube private stream as a fallback.

Plan (short):
- Primary: Zoom (link below)
- Fallback: private YouTube stream — attendees can use either link if Zoom has issues
- Host backup: Marissa will lead if I'm pulled into a customer escalation; Karthik will handle the product walkthrough if Marissa needs to hand off.

Attached: agenda + calendar invite (please re-add to your calendar if you rely on the Zoom link).

Can each of you confirm you can join either link and whether you prefer to keep questions in Q&A or live?

Thanks,
Ben
